title: The Board Beneath the Board

features.name: logic rooted in soil
features.desc-on-touch: A circuit board that has learned to grow. Its traces follow the same paths as root systems. Logic and life speak the same language down here.

features.name: the root-that-calculates
features.desc-on-touch: A root that branches into decision trees. Each split is a choice the land has already made. The pattern is so familiar, so inevitable, that you realize this tree was always computing.

features.name: sap flowing through circuits
features.desc-on-touch: You watch current and chlorophyll trade places. Neither one owns the path anymore. Both move together through channels that serve both electricity and life.

features.name: the mapping that understands itself
features.desc-on-touch: A diagram that is also a network. A network that is also a map. The distinction has dissolved. You are looking at both and neither at once.

features.name: green computing its own growth
features.desc-on-touch: Bright, vivid, the board beneath the board reads itself like a plant reads sunlight. It knows the algorithm of chlorophyll. It recognizes itself in every leaf.

inscription: here the board learned it was growing roots all along

file.name: Logic_Trace_Becomes_Vegetation_Diagram.schematic
file.note: A schematic that looks like a root system. A root system that calculates. The maker's identity is unclear; the file may be growing new copies of itself.
